findings.reason: without a declared control (§7, §10 and §40 all declare one) the node has no way to demonstrate the once-per-change emission is load-bearing rather than incidental to the fixture.
findings.text: §8's done-when asserts exactly one drain line, a peer's working run not preventing it, and a second drain line on promotion, but names no negative control and no red log, unlike every sibling section, so its gate cannot show the drain rule fires

findings.reason: §11 is declared implementable but is unbuildable as written — no goal, no measure, no fence — so a dispatched node cannot know what to implement or where to write.
